'''Iskit Tyestin''' was one of the last supporters of the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]] elected to the [[Bakuran Senate]] before his planet joined the [[Alliance of Free Planets]]. He attempted to flee [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], but his escape craft was destroyed in the process.

[[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] would later use Iskit Tyestin's identity during [[Wraith Squadron]]'s [[Mission to Storinal]].
